title: Emergency Sanitation & Waste Disposal
description: Covers four emergency toilet options, from a bucket toilet to an outdoor latrine, and how to manage used waste bags, greywater, garbage, and pests. Includes handwashing, spotting sanitation-related illness, disinfecting without bleach, a supply checklist, and apartment, infant, and elder care situations.
shortDescription: Bucket toilets, bagged waste, greywater, garbage, and handwashing
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
